messages.author: 4a15de51da4445ae
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Struggling with model fitting in occuRN
parts:
Dear Tam,
 The example in the help file does work (see below) -- I just cut and pasted into an R console.

 I would not recommend any of the models in unmarked with only 7 sites, in general. Typically I would say 40-100 is probably a minimal number except for some very small models.   Nevertheless, you should be able to get the basic model (no covariates) to run  -- its not clear you tried this -- and even with 1 continuous observation covariate I think it should run ok.  So please try to simplify your model (no covariates) and work on getting that to run. But, like I said, results based on 7 sites are suspect in my view. 

regards
andy

For your dataset I would recommend using the K=50 option in occuRN as the estimates change until about K=50 is reached.  The default value of K is 25.

>   y = matrix(c(
